how.direct: accounts the public flow record (tla-flows/pnl) shows with stake left in a pool, each asked on the chain (all_staked_balances)
how.amp: every holder of the pool's amp token, from the chain's own list (bank denom_owners); each holder's LP = its part of the tokens outstanding × what the compounder has staked in the pool. amp_check gives, beside it, the tokens × the compounder's stated rate
how.check: per pool: the staking contract's total = the compounder's own stake + the direct stakers; what is not explained is "not_attributed" and is never spread over the others
how.accounts: deposits, withdrawals and claims of each listed account across the whole Alliance, from the public flow record; a claim is not tied to a pool. Also its voting power (vp, vp_pct of all voting power) and the bribes it has placed (brb_*), where it has any.
how.votes: voting power and where it is pointed: the hourly lock-holder record where it has the account, else the weekly voting rollup. A pool's votes = the sum of voting power × the share each voter gives it. vote_vp / vote_pct on a holder row = the votes that account gives that pool.
how.bribes: the voting rollup's briber ledger: bribes placed, by account and pool, valued in dollars when placed. brb_n / brb_usd on a holder row = the bribes that account placed on that pool. A bribe in a token the ledger has no price for adds nothing to a dollar sum: those tokens are listed beside it (np, unpriced, brb_np), and every dollar figure and every share of dollars leaves them out.
how.names: a name is one the account registered; a label is one the address catalog has verified. Nothing else is named.
how.units: lp = LP tokens in the token's smallest unit; pct = share of the pool's staked LP

claims_all.note: every claim on the public flow record, by all wallets ever — also those that hold nothing now; valued as LUNA at the price of the day of the claim
